title: Gemini Hydrogen CAD
body:
I used Gemini 4 Hydrogen (XHigh) to rebuild the ornate timber and cast-iron bench from the same image reference I used with Astra 6 Pro. It produced editable, parameterized source, a STEP assembly with 51 separate parts, and a GLB.

The same source also generates a 25% wider bench. The slats get longer while keeping their cross-sections, the frames keep their proportions, and the assembly adds a second intermediate support.

The video rotates the earlier Astra bench, then reveals Hydrogen with a diagonal wipe. The old bench has textures; Hydrogen’s GLB has four basic materials without baked textures. Dimensions and hidden construction are inferred from the reference.

[Earlier Astra 6 Pro bench](https://rareskey.github.io/devlog/#update-cad-pro-debian-2026-10-29-astra-6-pro-cad).

videos.caption: Astra 6 Pro bench, followed by Gemini 4 Hydrogen (XHigh), with a diagonal wipe. Original exported materials.
